title: alyssum balkanicum var. depressum
intro: Alyssum balkanicum var. depressum, commonly known as Balkan alyssum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its small white flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. Balkan alyssum is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids and flavonoids, although further research is needed to confirm their effects and benefits.
